How do I use it correctly to get the best result?
Message from YETI Virtual Outfitter:
To get the best cold-holding performance from your cooler: 
Pre-cool the cooler a few hours before use with a sacrificial bag of ice, or store it somewhere cool before loading.
Line the base with YETI® Ice Blocks or YETI® Ice Sheets.
Add large ice cubes or blocks of ice.
Pre-chill your food and drinks before packing them whenever possible.
Use a 2:1 ratio of ice to chilled contents—about two-thirds ice and one-third food, drinks, or bait.
Fill empty spaces with more ice, towels, or rags, since warm air speeds up ice melt.
Limit how often you open the cooler and keep it shaded when possible.
Leave the cold melted water inside; drain it only if exposed food or meat could come into contact with it.
For hard coolers, dry ice can keep contents cold and frozen longer, but it isn’t compatible with Hopper® Soft Coolers.
